summary: Eltek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of an annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for August 11, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: re-election of directors, election of an external director, approval of exculpation and indemnification letters, re-appointment of auditors, and review of financial statements. Record date is July 9, 2026. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or delisting is referenced. This is a standard shareholder meeting notice with no transactional or structural event.
